# Fetch all liked songs (paginate)
liked_song_ids = []
page_index = 0
while True:
    page = apis.spotify.show_liked_songs(access_token=access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=20)
    if not page:
        break
    liked_song_ids.extend([song['song_id'] for song in page])
    if len(page) < 20:
        break
    page_index += 1
print("Total liked songs:", len(liked_song_ids))
print("Liked song IDs:", liked_song_ids)
